origin_name: # 1) For each trip enter the origin and destination train station names in their local language.
# 2) Specify the country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format e.g. CH FR DE) for both origin and destination.
# 3) Enter the user's institutional ID (SCIPER) if known. This field is optional for external travelers.
# 4) Enter the departure date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). If unknown leave blank.
# 5) Specify the number of trips taken on this route.
# 6) Specify the cabin class: either first or second class.
# 7) For detailed guidance consult the documentation under: Modules specification - Professional travel
# 8) Important: every line starting with # is an instruction. The importer ignores them so you can leave them in the file.
